text:
maya: Quick qtr OKR tide-check — owners please drop a one-line status for your milestone: shipped/slipped, short reason, next step + owner, PRs/links if any. Spreadsheet: https://go/internal/qtr-okrs (add row). Ping reviewers where needed. :wave:

alex: runtime-v3 autoscale -> shipped. Canary rolled 03/19, latency 99p within SLOs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/482. next: alex -> monitor 24h, then ramp to 30% traffic. @pete fyi for routing checks.

pete: frontend sticky-routing -> slipped. Saw cookie attr edge-case breaking sticky sessions in edge pods; failing e2e. root cause being investigated, reproducer local. next: pete -> fix + add e2e; target PR by EOD Tue. assigning @kelly for CR.

sam: embeddings v2 infra -> shipped. Cost profile improved ~18% after cache tuning. Docs updated in /docs/embeddings. No blockers right now.

nora: data-pipeline backfill -> slipped. Blocked by staging GCP quota; raised ticket INC-542 and asked infra for quota bump. next: nora -> follow quota ticket, resume backfill Wed once quota granted.

jin: eval-suite regression -> partial/shipped cores, but regression on summarization evals. Rollout paused until root-cause triaged. PR: https://github.com/redwood/evals/pull/120. Need @sam to help check model input normalization. next: jin -> triage with sam today.

maya: thanks — can we standardize "next" lines so I can summarize quickly? e.g. `next: <owner> -> <task>` — small asks only.

alex: next: alex -> 24h monitor (confirming above).

pete: next: pete -> reproduce with staging flag + ship fix (on me).

kelly: reviewing frontend PR today, aiming to finish CR by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: runtime-canary-2026-03-19 at 18:12 UTC :rocket:

sam: fyi billing alert triggered 03:00 for embeddings spike; we increased cache TTL 5->20s and costs normalized. next: sam -> watch billing alerts for 48h.

maya: perfect — I'll compile a short status doc and send to leadership by EOD. If anyone hasn't posted PR links or tickets, drop them here now so I can link them. :memo:

alex: PR again: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/482

nora: quota ticket: https://console.cloud.google.com/issues/INC-542 (added details)

jin: eval PR: https://github.com/redwood/evals/pull/120 — tagging @maya for regression notes.

pete: thanks all, will update the sheet after PR is up. :thumbsup:
